preconditions.description: Attacker must have some WBTC tokens to open a position
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability allows users to pass arbitrary prices when opening and closing positions. Attack strategy: 1) Open a position with a manipulated low price to acquire more tokens than deserved. 2) Close the position with a manipulated high price to extract more value. 3) Alternatively, manipulate prices to create profitable arbitrage opportunities. The exact functions to call depend on the trading/position logic not shown in the provided code, but the core issue is that price parameters are user-controlled rather than obtained from a trusted oracle.
